verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, DLC provenance, mechanics, Counter Skills taxonomy, and Ultimate Finish evidence. Preserve unsupported numeric/probability fields as null.
research_scope: Heroic Counter — Strike Super / universal counter research.

verification_audit.method: Reconciled repository research with Xenoverse 2-specific skill/counter documentation and official Bandai Namco DLC documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No duplicate repository research batch found; Heroic Counter remains a single Super Skill identity.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Heroic Counter is a Super / Strike entry and a Counter Skill. The Counter Skill taxonomy describes it as a universal counter capable of responding to both Strike/melee and Ki attacks.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Heroic Counter is obtained from PQ155 — I Need a Hero... Pose!. The repository reward guide records it as a Basic Reward. Official Bandai Namco documentation confirms PQs and additional moves are part of HERO OF JUSTICE Pack 1, which introduced Gamma 1, Gamma 2, and Gohan (DBS Super Hero).
verification_audit.dlc_finding: HERO OF JUSTICE Pack 1 launched on 2022-11-10 and contains four Parallel Quests and seven additional moves; the skill's PQ155 route therefore carries the Pack 1 DLC dependency for a player without that content.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains false because repository reward evidence places Heroic Counter in the PQ155 Basic Reward slot; no reviewed source establishes an Ultimate Finish gate.
verification_audit.cost_policy: 100 Ki is retained; stamina cost and drop probability remain null.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: Heroic Counter uses a defensive pose/barrier-like stance, can counter incoming Strike/melee and Ki attacks under the universal-counter taxonomy, then warp behind the opponent for a spinning kick; additional input can trigger the warp/attack sequence separately. Exact frames/damage remain unresolved.

records.name: Heroic Counter
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 155 — I Need a Hero... Pose!
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide lists Heroic Counter under PQ155 Basic Reward.
records.skill_description: A Strike Super counter that uses a heroic pose and barrier-like stance to intercept an incoming attack, then vanishes behind the opponent for a spinning kick; additional input can trigger a warp attack without relying on the initial counter hit.
records.mechanics_notes: Xenoverse 2 counter documentation places Heroic Counter in the universal-counter group, allowing response to both melee/Strike and Ki attacks. On a successful counter the user warps behind the opponent for a spinning kick; additional input can trigger the warp/attack sequence separately. Exact frame windows, damage, and matchup-specific behavior remain version-sensitive.
records.acquisition_notes: Future Warrior route: PQ155 — I Need a Hero... Pose!. Repository reward evidence places Heroic Counter in the Basic Reward list. Official Bandai Namco confirms HERO OF JUSTICE Pack 1 contains four PQs and seven additional moves and introduced Gamma 2, establishing the DLC provenance for this PQ/skill family. Exact drop probability remains unresolved.
records.pve_notes: PQ155 farming is the documented Future Warrior route. Basic-reward evidence does not establish an Ultimate Finish requirement.
records.pvp_notes: Universal counter behavior allows Heroic Counter to respond to both melee/Strike and Ki attacks. Community discussion reports that the skill also has utility through its additional-input warp, but detailed matchup and frame behavior is version-sensitive.
